newsitem.title: USA: FSA hires Kennedy for muni surveillance.
newsitem.headline: FSA hires Kennedy for muni surveillance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Wednesday it hired Dina Kennedy, previously a manager of municipal risk at Enhance Financial Services Group Inc., as a director in it municipal surveillance unit.
Kennedy will be responsible for monitoring the majority of FSA-insured revenue bonds, the company said.
From 1990 to 1994, Kennedy was a vice president and assistant director in the public finance department at Moody's Investors Service Inc.
FSA is a unit of Financial Security Assurance Holdings Ltd.
